title: Greywater Bay Rising Again
author: Theo Okafor
blurb: Silas Joubert, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
